info.title: Strip Zenesis conventions (document-independent)
info.x-note: Recursive descent, so this works unchanged on ANY Zenesis spec. It only DELETES. It cannot convert x-zenesis-enums-desc into x-enumDescriptions, cannot fold x-zenesis-sections, x-zenesis-statuscodes or x-zenesis-security into a description, and cannot un-swap example summary/description, because Overlay actions carry literal values rather than transforms. Using this file DISCARDS real API documentation. Prefer `zenesis-oas convert`.
